defs.def: an idea or a principle that is connected with sth abstract 概念；观念

ex.s: This adaptability ensures that complex historical concepts become accessible and engaging for young minds.
ex.t: 这种适应性确保复杂的历史概念能够被年轻的心灵所理解和喜爱。

ex.s: That the concept has a history is easily ignored.
ex.t: 这个概念有其历史，这一点很容易被忽视。

ex.s: The concept of elevation is relative.
ex.t: 海拔的概念是相对的。

ex.s: Artwork Statement: Please provide a brief statement (maximum 150 words) outlining your artwork concept.
ex.t: 作品阐述：请提供一段简要说明（最多150词），概述你的作品构思。

ex.s: For example, I’m a car enthusiast, so when I teach physics, I contextualize concepts with my knowledge about cars.
ex.t: 例如，我是个汽车迷，所以教物理时，我会用自己的汽车知识来让概念更具体。

ex.s: When I first brought my hobbies to my classroom, I was focused on how doing so would build engagement and help my students understand concepts in science.
ex.t: 最初把爱好带进课堂时，我关注的是这样做能如何提高参与度、帮助学生理解科学概念。

ex.s: I find that doing so energizes my instruction, engages my students, and demonstrates to them how abstract concepts play out in the real world.
ex.t: 我发现，这样做让我的教学更有活力，让学生更投入，也向他们展示了抽象概念在现实世界中的实际运用。

ex.s: To illustrate a scientific concept.
ex.t: 为了阐明一个科学概念。

ex.s: Restaurants like Silo in the UK have experimented with zero-waste systems, but wastED took the concept to its logical conclusion.
ex.t: 像英国 Silo 这样的餐厅已尝试过零浪费系统，但 wastED 采取了更进一步的方式……

ex.s: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume — even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
ex.t: 相反，她建议采用营养专家中一个知名的理念，叫做“责任分工”：父母在固定时间给孩子提供各种大多健康的食物，而孩子自己决定想吃什么、吃多少——即便这意味着偶尔吃更多饼干而非胡萝卜。

ex.s: The concept was born when German city planners sought to plant large areas of parkland after World War II in a reproducible way that would need minimal maintenance.
ex.t: 这一理念诞生于二战后德国城市规划者寻求以可复制、低维护的方式种植大片绿地之时。

ex.s: Led by the concept of “right plant, right place,” they match plants that enjoy the same soil, sun and weather conditions, and arrange them according to their patterns of growth.
ex.t: 在“合适的植物，合适的位置”这一理念引领下，他们把喜好相同土壤、阳光和天气条件的植物搭配在一起，并按其生长模式排列。

ex.s: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas or to take a role in explaining new concepts and policies to others.
ex.t: 请听众贡献想法，或让他们承担向他人解释新概念和新政策的角色。

ex.s: Societies all over the world view the concept of an adult as self-supporting and self-directed, because it identifies a point in the life cycle.
ex.t: 全世界的社会的都把“成年人”这一概念视为能够自立和自主，因为它标示了生命周期中的一个节点。

ex.s: You can also find students on the class discussion board to organize a study group, or schedule in-person meetings with your professor to discuss course concepts.
ex.t: 你也可以在课堂讨论板上找同学组建学习小组，或约教授当面讨论课程概念。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: Unsurprisingly, these new concepts inspire us to build new models of the universe.
ex.t: 不足为奇的是，这些新概念激励我们建立新的宇宙模型。

ex.s: These universal norms far pre-date the concept of any moralising religion or written law.
ex.t: 这些普遍规范远早于任何宗教道德化观念或成文法律的出现。

ex.s: According to Jim Hart, the “hedgehog concept” is one of the factors that lead companies to greatness.
ex.t: 根据吉姆·哈特的说法，“刺猬概念”是引领公司走向卓越的因素之一。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都会占用大量空间，而且尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，却很少有人喜欢附近安装大型太阳能板。

ex.s: In one experiment carried out at the National University of Singapore, participants were given the task of learning concepts on a difficult subject.
ex.t: 在新加坡国立大学进行的一项实验中，参与者被赋予学习一门困难学科概念的任务。

ex.s: One reason is that ALife is a field in which the central concept — life itself — is undefined.
ex.t: 一个原因是，ALife是一个核心概念——生命本身——尚未被定义的研究领域。

ex.s: Engineers are now working on a new concept: the rail drones of the future.
ex.t: 工程师们正在研究一个新概念：未来的铁路无人机。

ex.s: Tiny forests were first pioneered as a concept in the 1970s by Dr Miyawaki, a Japanese botanist.
ex.t: 小森林的概念最早由日本植物学家宫胁博士在20世纪70年代开创。

ex.s: As he went on to share his concept with others, the idea soon took off in India and other countries before eventually reaching Europe, where it became popular in places like France, Belgium and the Netherlands.
ex.t: 当他与其他人分享他的概念时，这个想法很快在印度和其他国家流行起来，最终传到欧洲，在法国、比利时和荷兰等地受欢迎。

ex.s: The concept of beauty today is very different from what it was in ancient Greece or the Middle Ages, and so are most of our “laws” of nature.
ex.t: 如今美的概念与古希腊或中世纪时的概念大不相同，我们大多数自然"定律"也是如此。

ex.s: As cool as it may be to receive a postcard written in Chinese, the concept doesn’t work if one doesn’t understand it.
ex.t: 收到用中文写的明信片也许很酷，但如果不懂中文，这个概念就行不通。

ex.s: It's almost impossible to learn about one historical period without having dozens of questions about related concepts.
ex.t: 不了解一个历史时期，几乎不可能不对相关概念产生几十个问题。

ex.s: Understand the Economic Concept of a Budget Line
ex.t: 理解预算线的经济学概念

ex.s: The budget line is an elementary concept that most consumers understand intuitively without a need for graphs and equations — it's the household budget, for example.
ex.t: 预算线是一个基本概念，多数消费者凭直觉就能理解，无需图表和方程——比如家庭预算。

ex.s: As it turns out, however, this same concept-one that most consumers make many times each day with reflecting on it-is the basis of the more formal budget line concept in economics , which is explained below.
ex.t: 然而，事实证明，同一个概念——大多数消费者每天都会做出许多次、却不去反思的概念——是经济学中更正式的预算线概念的基础，下文将作解释。

ex.s: Before turning to the economics definition of budget line, consider another concept: the line-item budget.
ex.t: 这种用法没有什么复杂的地方，预算线就是预算中的一行，上面注明了要购买的服务或商品及其成本，

ex.s: The Budget Line as an Economics Concept
ex.t: 在形式化的过程中，这个概念可以被表达为一个可以普遍应用的数学方程。

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

ex.s: In the process of formalization, the concept can be expressed as a mathematical equation that can be applied generally.
ex.t: 要理解这一点，想象一张图，其中垂直线量化你可以购买多少张电影票。水平线量化你可以购买多少本犯罪小说。

ex.s: A well-known bilingual writer, Lin brought the concept of humour to modern Chinese literature.
ex.t: 作为一位著名的双语作家，林语堂将幽默的概念引入到现代中国文学中。

ex.s: Lin even created an equation to explain this concept: Reality + Dreams + Humour = Wisdom.
ex.t: Lin甚至创造了一个等式来解释这个概念：现实+梦想+幽默=智慧。

ex.s: The “closed” concept meant that the space was designed to function with its own oxygen, food and water, needing nothing from the outside world.
